source.quote: Note — There is some difference of opinion about the interpretation of the word Uchchanatha. Suppose Saturn is in the Aries in debilitation who will be Uchchanatha of Saturn? According to one view Saturn is exalted in Libra. Therefore lord of Libra, namely, Venus is the Uchchanatha. Another view is that Saturn being in Aries and the Sun is exalted in Aries. Therefore the Sun is the Uchchanatha. In our view the second view is more appropriate. There is also difference of opinion whether the conditions mentioned above have to be fulfilled before debilitation gets cancelled. Shri V. Subrahmanaya Shastri has taken the view that any of the two conditions should be enough for the cancellation of the debilitation. Pt. Gopesh Kumar Ojha has taken the view that both the conditions have to be fulfilled. We are of the view that it should be enough for any of the two conditions to be fulfilled for the cancellation of the debilitation. Our view and that of Shri Shastri is supported by Jataka Parijata.

The seventh classical graha, the Moon itself (Cancer's own lord), is not given a branch: `compound_relationship(Moon,Moon,*)` is structurally never emitted -- the natural-relationship table carries no self-relation -- so a Moon branch would be dead code, not a narrower reading of the verse. "Aspected fully by Venus" is `aspects(Venus,Moon)`, the same full-drishti-onto-a-graha shape Milestone 37 already used. Zero new engine capability beyond dep.compound-friendship itself: `in_varga_sign` (D9, Milestone 29) and `aspects` (onto a graha) both reused exactly as declared.

cards.note: INTERPRETIVE STEP TAKEN AND RECORDED: "the 3rd, 6th and 11th house counted from the house occupied by the lord of Lagna, Moon or from the Lagna" is read as three ALTERNATIVE reference points (any of: the Lagna-lord's own house, the Moon, the Lagna itself), each requiring malefics in ALL THREE of the 3rd/6th/11th counted from that one reference point -- a plain-grammar reading of the printed list ("the 3rd, 6th and 11th", conjunctive "and") rather than a disjunctive "any one of" reading, and not the same word-level dispute v.26's own "or" carried (no Note or worked example addresses this sentence). "From the Lagna" uses `in_house` directly (already Lagna-relative under whole-sign houses) rather than `in_house_from`, since the Lagna itself is not a chart body (the same architecture gap `dep.lagna-strength`'s own Decision 0b already named) and does not need to be, given the houses are already counted from it. "The house occupied by the lord of Lagna" binds a fresh variable via `lord_of_house(?ll,1)` and reuses it as `in_house_from`'s reference, the general graha-frame mechanism `dep.graha-frame` already provides for any pair of grahas, not only the Moon. No distinctness constraint is placed on ?m1/?m2/?m3: three simultaneously-satisfying facts cannot in fact be the same graha, since one graha cannot occupy three different houses from the same reference at once, so none is invented.
